item.title: Dodgers’ Dave Roberts thrilled to have Kiké Hernandez, Evan Phillips back
item.description: Neither player is likely to play before midseason following elbow surgeries, but Roberts says there is value in having both back as the team adds depth while chasing a third straight World Series title.

item.description: What's the median age for someone to get married? You might be surprised.

item.title: Lakers’ Luka Doncic ‘progressing good’ but All-Star status is unclear
item.description: Doncic remains day-to-day ahead of Sunday’s USA vs. the World event at the Intuit Dome, but the soonest he will return to regular-season games is next Friday.

item.title: Emotional Casey Mears avoids crash, qualifies for Daytona 500
item.description: Mears survives a series of setbacks to finish eighth in one of Thursday’s two qualifying races, earning one of the final two spots for Sunday’s season opener. Joey Logano and Chase Elliott win the qualifying races to earn starting spots on the second row.

item.title: USC women beat Indiana to extend win streak to 5 games
item.description: Jazzy Davidson has 24 points, Kara Dunn scores 16 and Kennedy Smith adds 15 as the Trojans rely on stingy defense and a strong showing at the free-throw line to outlast the Hoosiers, 79-73.

item.title: LeBron James becomes oldest to record a triple-double as Lakers top Mavericks
item.description: The 41-year-old James finishes with 28 points, 12 assists and 10 rebounds in a 124-104 victory, giving the Lakers seven wins in their past 11 games as they head into the All-Star break.

item.title: CBU women’s basketball team sees WAC lead shrink with loss to Southern Utah
item.description: The Lancers' lead in the Western Athletic Conference was slashed in half after Southern Utah posted a wire-to-wire victory Thursday night in Riverside.
